Redefine_Guidelines: Product requirements must be clearly defined, focusing on customer-facing improvements and visible touchpoints.

Functional and experience improvements require measurable metrics.
Requests for Feature requirement/Experience & Warranty Improvement must be routed to Function owners (Marketing/GxD/TME) for holistic assessment.
Do not include best practices in PRD.

Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Proposal: State what the customer expects instead of vague statements like equal or better than predecessor.
